image_description: A close-up, low-angle view of a modern architectural railing system (bannister) in an indoor public space. The primary subject is a thick, metallic handrail with a brushed finish, supported by black vertical posts. In the background, there is a glass balustrade with metal clamps and a second level of the building visible. The foreground features a textured, possibly stone or concrete, base structure.
